members.name: Dr Mike Dewever
members.bio: Specialist Doctor in Reconstructive and Aesthetic Plastic Surgery. GDC No. 47127. Degree in Medicine and Surgery in 2010 from the University of Barcelona. Specialist in Reconstructive and Aesthetic Plastic Surgery, completing residency (MIR) from 2011-2016, in the Department of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery at Bellvitge University Hospital, Barcelona.

members.name: Dr. Ainitze Ibarzabal
members.bio: Since 2007, they have specialised in gastrointestinal surgery, with a particular focus on bariatric surgery, having performed over 500 procedures (both primary and revision surgeries), and are currently considered a leading figure in this technique.

members.name: Dr Valenti Puig Divi
members.bio: Graduated in Medicine and Surgery from the Central University of Barcelona with an extraordinary degree award, he specialised in Digestive System in 1994.

members.name: Dr. David Pérez Asensio
members.bio: His clinical work involves being an associate professor on the Medicine degree programme at the University of Girona, and he is a member of the Catalan Society of Endocrinology and Nutrition and the Obesity Group of the Spanish Society of Endocrinology.

members.name: Dr Claudia Vera Ching
members.bio: I hold a Master's degree in Aesthetic Medicine with international recognition from Esneca Business School, and I specialised in Intensive Care Medicine at the Josep Trueta University Hospital in Girona.

members.name: Dr Alberto Gonzalez
members.bio: With a solid background in medicine and a specialisation in advanced hair treatments. They graduated in General Medicine in 2020 from the University of Medical Sciences of Villa Clara, Cuba, and subsequently specialised in Aesthetic Medicine with a master's degree from the distance learning centre TECH in Spain (2022), completing a Master's Degree in Continuing Education at the European University Miguel de Cervantes (2024).

members.name: Dr. Úrsula Ramírez
